title: Consolidated volume & bucket constructs with cross-account lockdown and snapshot guardrails
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a consolidated Terraform construct to provision and manage EBS volumes, EFS filesystems, and S3 buckets for VPC/private deployments that enforces encryption-first defaults, cross-account lockdown (replication-only where required), immutable snapshot guardrails, and built-in health checks. This module must provide a safe upgrade path from the current 'storage-iaac' modules and include preflight checks for drift and mount/endpoint validation. The goal is to reduce duplication across private deployments, make backups auditable, and enable automated recovery workflows while keeping least-privilege access and compliance controls in place.
tasks: Design new module interface (inputs/outputs) that supports: kms_key_alias, snapshot_retention_days, s3_replication_role_arn, allow_vpc_only_access, encryption_context_polices
Implement EBS sub-module: encrypted-by-default, snapshot lifecycle (create/lock/immutable tag), tags for cost center and owner
Implement EFS sub-module: encrypted-at-rest, mount targets in private subnets, lifecycle policy for backup to snapshots
Implement S3 sub-module: default BlockPublicAccess, enforce bucket-owner-full-control ACL, configure replication and lifecycle rules for cross-account recovery buckets
Add Terraform null_resource preflight checks for: kms key existence/rotation schedule, bucket public-block compliance, EFS mount target sanity, example: using aws cli in CI
Add healthcheck Lambda + CloudWatch Event rule to validate snapshot creation and mountability weekly
Provide drift-detection support: terraform plan hook that fails on destructive changes to encryption/KMS bindings
Write migration guide from legacy modules to new consolidated module with automated tfstate migration examples
Create CI pipeline changes: terratest for behavior, nightly plan runs against staging accounts
Open RFC + design doc and collect security review approval
acceptance_criteria: New module can be used to deploy EBS/EFS/S3 with encryption enabled by default and no manual post-deploy config
Snapshot lifecycle policy automatically snapshots EBS volumes and tags immutable snapshots for 14 days by default
S3 buckets created by module have BlockPublicAccess enabled and VPC-only access enforced via access points when requested
Cross-account replication can be configured via a single replication_role_arn input; replication only writes to a pre-approved recovery account
Automated preflight checks run in CI and catch missing KMS alias or public ACLs
Module provides clear tfstate migration instructions and a tested migration plan for at least two customer templates
Security review sign-off captured in design doc and release notes
